findings: Verified: quick grid is 5 emoji + '+' tile (aria-label 'Więcej emoji', text glyph, no icon font); 🙏 is no longer a quick tile and is reachable via the People tab (dataset contains it, legacy ❤ is already the fully-qualified U+2764 U+FE0F so the picker's ❤️ and the quick ❤️ are the same stored value, no duplicate reaction).

Verified: dataset is 9 categories, 1870 unique emoji, 0 skin-tone sequences, 0 control/HTML characters, max 8 code points (<= VARCHAR(16)), 14567 bytes raw, same-origin, package.json/package-lock.json untouched. Server validation is exact Set membership + typeof string + length <= 32; I ran it directly: accepts 🎉 🙏 ZWJ 👩‍❤️‍💋‍👨 🇵🇱 #️⃣; rejects '', 'a', '', '"', '🎉🎉', '🎉\n', NUL, 👍🏽, 5000 chars, number/array/object/null. Fails closed to the legacy six if the dataset is absent. No SQL in routes/chat.js or lib/chat.js filters on the allowlist, and the DB column (VARCHAR(16) utf8mb4_bin) needs no change.

Verified: picker onSelect calls the same toggle(sheetMessageId, emoji) + closeSheet() as the quick tiles (optimistic, same POST, toggle-off, rollback). Roving tabindex gives a single grid tab stop; focusables() skips tabindex=-1 and [hidden]; Escape/overlay close from both modes; back returns to quick with focus on '+'. paintSheet() only flips aria-pressed in full mode so polling cannot steal focus.

Verified: all emoji-derived attributes in chat-reactions.js go through the new quote-safe escAttr; emoji-picker.js uses createElement/textContent/setAttribute only (no innerHTML). Chip order is a total order (legacy six 0-5, dataset 100+index, code-unit tie-break, unknown -> MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, never NaN). Unnamed-emoji label is 'Reakcja <emoji>: N ...'.

Verified: wiadomosci.html links chat-reactions.css?v=4, chat-reactions.js?v=4, emoji-data.js?v=1, emoji-picker.js?v=1; sw.js has the exact same four URLs and CACHE_NAME 'prezenty-v133'; wiadomosci-page.js (?v=2), home-page.css, package.json, package-lock.json are not in the diff. emoji-data.js is only loaded by wiadomosci.html (the only browser page using chat-reactions.js). [hidden] vs display:grid/flex handled explicitly in CSS; reduced-motion block added; 44px tab/emoji targets and fixed-height sheet capped by the viewport (geometry covered by the 320/375/768/1024 spec).
Verified by running it myself: full `npm test` in the worktree = 146 passed, 11 skipped (existing fixmes), 0 failed; working tree clean afterwards.
Non-blocking: closeSheet() does not call picker.reset(), so the picker reopens on the last-used category (documented design choice in FEAT-002; the sheet itself always reopens in quick view).

Non-blocking: unqualified emoji (e.g. bare U+2764 without FE0F) are rejected with the normal 400 because membership is against fully-qualified sequences; only matters for third-party API clients, the UI always sends qualified values.
Non-blocking: no per-message cap on distinct emoji now that ~1870 values are allowed; only the existing 30/10s reaction throttle limits chip growth (accepted in plan D4).
Non-blocking: glyphs from Emoji 15.0 render as boxes on an OS emoji font older than 15.0; no runtime font probing (accepted in plan D2).

Non-blocking: not verifiable here - real two-account MySQL smoke test (demo mode runs no SQL), real phone/on-screen keyboard, screen-reader pass, browsers other than Chromium/Edge, and real service-worker install/offline behaviour (sw.js only checked by string assertions).
